title: nfl.com terms §1.3 bars compiled retrieval absent written consent
detail: Section 1.3 prohibits 'systematic retrieval of data … to create or compile … a database' absent express prior written consent. The row-level table, CSVs and transcript are published from the repo, and Pages serves the repo root. This is a user decision (Q-13, S-06); it does not block merge. Repo precedent: earlier desks also publish row-level official data.
